name: CyberSecPro
description: WhatsApp Bot Management SaaS - link numbers via pairing codes, manage sessions from a cyberpunk dashboard.

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB connection string - REQUIRED. Get a free cluster at mongodb.com/atlas

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key for signing JWT auth tokens.

APP_URL.description: Your Heroku app URL - used for keepalive pings so bots stay online. Format: https://YOUR-APP-NAME.herokuapp.com

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email for the auto-created admin account.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the auto-created admin account (min 6 chars).

NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION.description: Must be false so devDependencies are installed for the React build step.

NPM_CONFIG_LEGACY_PEER_DEPS.description: Use legacy peer deps resolution to avoid install conflicts.

WHATSAPP_HOST_DYNO.description: Run WhatsApp bots on the web dynos. The dynos shard linked numbers between themselves.

BOT_ISOLATION.description: Use isolated mode so the supervisor can rotate and recover bots one-by-one.

DYNO_TOTAL_RAM_MB.description: Actual RAM ceiling of each web dyno.

MAX_CONCURRENT_BOTS.description: Maximum active WhatsApp bot processes per web dyno on a 512 MB plan.

TOTAL_WEB_DYNOS.description: Number of web dynos used for WhatsApp bot sharding. Eco plans support one web dyno; increase this after upgrading the plan.

BOT_CHILD_HEAP_MB.description: V8 heap limit for each bot child process. Keep this lean on Eco dynos.

MAX_MEM_PERCENT.description: Stop spawning new bot children once projected memory crosses this percent of the dyno limit.

MAX_BOTS_PER_DYNO.description: Hard cap on bots per dyno. Leave empty for no limit.
